folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B375: corrected premises and evidence limits
folds.body:
This complete plan and its lane receipt were reviewed as one chronological record. F1's missing look owner is superseded by DESIGN; M3's missing root hook is already corrected in the receipt, which preserves the existing `data-world` writer. M1's definition-owned typed effects and legacy replay draws remain useful; a shared fight surface does not merge native and tempo engines or type a native strike twice. M4's arrival voice cannot establish a work-result line or all-place voice coverage.

The old full-suite row's printed total/pass/fail values are not internally consistent; retain that receipt without treating it as a clean run. A clean checkout skipping absent private-pack cases is not a passing comparison for branch cases that actually execute. Moving failures under high load motivate a matched-input/load reproduction but do not clear a regression. Old PIDs, writer claims, budget limits, worktree-only dispatch and proposed guarded merge steps are dated instructions, not renewed authorization. Current DESIGN/UI_RULES, AD41/42/51 and a selected task govern further work. No merge, runtime or screenshot was newly verified.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B375: gallery freedom, method proof and truthful blockers
folds.body:
The complete [gallery form brief](../gm/dispatch/ui-refactor-wave-2026-10-29/GALLERY_FORM_AUDIT_BRIEF.md) retains L1–L6, R2-0–R2-6 and AB1–AB12 as creative possibilities. The later Luminous-only request, functional-home direction and prose-first refinement govern earlier paper/illustrated drafts. Worker picks remain worker picks. Preserve explicit noun labels, decision-shaped detail, accessible text, knowledge-qualified precision and exceptions that deserve words. Bare blocks or initials must not push the subject into hover. Unknown, locked, lost and merely possible are distinct states; drawing one shared glow grammar cannot disclose unknown existence or invent a precise measurement. Automatic saved familiarity thinning, global density settings, all-six-run drafting, word quotas and mandatory user selection remain proposals/history rather than new gates.

The full [cultivation correction checkpoint](../gm/dispatch/cultivation-spacing-2026-10-22/CHECKPOINT.md) supplies concrete method distinctions: played eligible mist practice, independent reserve/control, practice at a full pool, pause during absence/rawness/trial, frozen purification odds and no pending-method switch. Optional-state absence preserves legacy behavior; selecting a method invents no prior training. Preserve those mechanisms and original-world status without universalizing a realm ladder. Its first post-import Here captures did not show the method panel. The later actual Projects continuation and final opaque sticky-header correction have separate six-case visual evidence; native trial settlement/persistence and screenshot-shaped log fixtures are different proof kinds. A staged frozen snapshot is not adopted or installed-runtime evidence.

The full [M2 reason checkpoint](../gm/dispatch/m2-blocked-reasons-2026-10-26/CHECKPOINT.md) distinguishes a wrong explanation from a wrong gate. Its old probe-gated Tingen start needed the actual developer-readiness reason, not “nothing else under way”; shared prerequisite copy names its known place. Tooltip-title evidence without a declared desktop viewport does not establish visible, keyboard-accessible reasons. Later LOTM starts supersede any reading of that receipt as today's universal entry restriction. Retain the useful visible-reason follow-up without changing gates or authorizing new gameplay. No new browser, app adoption, runtime or private-save proof follows from this content review.
